content: spring-ai-typesafe v0.1.0 (read from source at tag): starter depends only on typesafe-java-sdk + spring-boot-starter (no Spring AI dep; built vs Boot 4.0.7). Auto-config @ConditionalOnProperty(spring.ai.typesafe.api-key) and Assert.state(hasText) -> a present-but-blank key FAILS context startup. Uses cloned context RestClient.Builder (RestClientCustomizers apply) with own JdkClientHttpRequestFactory + spring.ai.typesafe.timeout. SDK has built-in RetryPolicy (2 retries, 500ms-5s backoff, 408/429/5xx+connection, 30s budget; spring.ai.typesafe.retry.max-retries). Exceptions: TypeSafeApiException subclasses BadRequest 400, Authentication 401, PermissionDenied 403 (missing key), UnprocessableEntity 422, RateLimit 429, InternalServer 5xx/Overloaded 529, ApiConnection/Timeout. systemOne(Map state, Map<String,Question>) -> SystemOneResponse(model, answers, usage, requestId); ScoreAnswer(value zero-indexed expected level, legend, probabilities, confidence); NoulAnswer(value). Score up to 10 levels. systemOneAll batch with concurrency (default 4). Published rate limit 1200 req/min.
